The case matters because it highlights deep-seated public concerns regarding domestic violence, accountability, and the transparency of law enforcement procedures in high-profile murder investigations. The family's ongoing demands underscore the broader challenges victims' relatives face in seeking justice through official channels in Pakistan.

stories.title: North Korea Denies Involvement in Massive $6.3 Billion Binance Heist
stories.summary:
North Korea has strongly rejected US allegations that it orchestrated a massive $6.3 billion cryptocurrency heist on the Binance platform, dismissing the claims as absurd rhetoric. The FBI recently stated that Pyongyang was responsible for stealing over $6 billion in digital assets, prompting Kim Yo Jong, the influential sister of leader Kim Jong Un, to declare that the accusations demonstrate continued US hostility. This comes as Binance works to stabilize operations and encourage customer deposits following substantial withdrawals.

Cybersecurity experts and blockchain analytics firms, including Chainalysis and Elliptic, maintain that North Korean hackers are major global crypto thieves who rely on illicit digital funds to finance the country's nuclear weapons and ballistic missile programs. Estimates suggest that North Korea has stolen $7.6 billion in cryptocurrency this year alone, with analysts noting that digital asset theft has become a vital economic lifeline for the regime amid international sanctions. The estimated Binance theft alone equals roughly a sixth of North Korea's total economic output for 2025.

In response to the security breach, Binance temporarily froze withdrawals before gradually reopening them for various assets. Despite net customer outflows amounting to approximately 3% of platform assets, overall user confidence has largely held up. The exchange also launched a community appreciation campaign featuring fee rebates and yield-generating incentives to encourage trading activity through November 21.

This dispute matters because it underscores escalating international tensions surrounding state-sponsored cybercrime and the funding of illicit weapons programs. It also highlights the growing financial vulnerabilities and resilience of major centralized cryptocurrency exchanges facing unprecedented security threats.

stories.title: Two Policemen Killed and One Injured in Attack on Polio Team Escort
stories.summary:
Two police officers lost their lives and another sustained injuries when unidentified armed attackers opened fire on their vehicle in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Mohmand district on Tuesday. The officers were en route to join a polio vaccination team for security duty during an ongoing immunization campaign. Headquarters Deputy Superintendent of Police Liaquat Ali confirmed that the violent incident occurred near the Hashim Kor police checkpost in the Dag Tamanzai area of Pindiali tehsil. The slain constables were identified as Zahoor Khan and Arbai Khan, while the wounded officer was named as Sepoy Sabir Khan.

In a separate development within the province, KP Governor Faisal Karim Kundi took official notice regarding reports of four polio workers being abducted in Tank district on Monday. Governor Kundi strongly condemned the abduction, labeling it regrettable and emphasizing that the government carries the responsibility of safeguarding immunization personnel. He stressed that targeting workers who protect children's health is entirely against humanity and national interests, directing local authorities to execute immediate and effective measures for their secure recovery.

These security breaches coincide with a sub-national polio vaccination drive launched across the country on Sunday, which aims to reach roughly 24 million children spread over 97 high-risk districts. Pakistan and neighboring Afghanistan remain the sole two nations globally where the poliovirus is still endemic. Just prior to the campaign, Pakistan reported its eighth polio case of the year involving a 13-month-old girl from Khyber district, with six of the total cases originating in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

Authorities have repeatedly highlighted persistent insecurity, particularly in the southern regions of KP, as the primary barrier to successfully administering vaccines to every child. Similar targeted violence has previously struck security details accompanying health workers, including an incident in September where two policemen were killed in Balochistan’s Noshki, and an April attack in KP’s Hangu that left one constable dead and four others wounded.

stories.title: Higher Education Commission Issues Warning Against Fraudulent Degree Attestation Agents
stories.summary:
The Higher Education Commission has formally issued a public advisory cautioning citizens against deceptive intermediaries and fraudulent agents who offer assistance with educational document attestation. According to the commission, certain unauthorized individuals have been posing as official agents to mislead applicants into believing they can facilitate the verification of academic certificates and other credentials through the HEC.

The regulatory body strongly advised members of the public to exercise maximum vigilance and avoid handing over personal information, academic transcripts, or educational documents to any unauthorized intermediaries. The commission emphasized that such offers are frequently tied to fraudulent schemes designed to exploit applicants and compromise sensitive personal and educational data.

Clarifying the actual procedures, the HEC noted that the entire verification and attestation workflow is conducted completely online and operates on a paperless basis. This digital system allows applicants to submit requests conveniently from their residences without relying on external agents. Citizens have been directed to complete the process independently by following instructions provided directly on the official HEC website.

For verified information, official submissions, and assistance with queries, individuals can access the commission's website or utilize its online helpdesk. Additionally, the HEC has established official helpline numbers, specifically 051-111-119-432 and 0334-1119432, to guide applicants safely through official channels and prevent potential fraud.

stories.title: How Online Misogyny Propelled Laiba Khan Lodhi into Professional Drifting
stories.summary:
In 2024, Laiba Khan Lodhi uploaded a video showcasing her drifting skills in a Mercedes, which she learned at the Pro Drift Academy Dubai. The footage quickly circulated within local street-racing circles, leading to a meme that mocked her driving and sparked a wave of misogynistic comments, abuse, and threats with slogans claiming women belong in the kitchen. Although initially disappointed, she channeled the negativity into determination to prove that female drivers belong on the motorsport track.

Growing up surrounded by cars thanks to her father’s automotive business in Islamabad, Laiba had developed an early emotional attachment to vehicles, though a professional driving career was never her initial ambition. When she decided to pursue drifting seriously, her parents offered full support, restoring her confidence against detractors. Because motorsports require significant financial investment for vehicle maintenance, track fees, and training, she achieved financial independence by creating automotive content, collaborating with brands, and running a modest-wear brand named Ajwa Modest Wear.

By 2026, Laiba had built a massive following on Instagram with millions of views on her drifting videos, becoming a recognized name in Pakistan's racing community. Earlier in the year, she represented Pakistan as the sole female competitor at the Saudi Toyota Drift Championship in Jeddah. Eager to test her limits further, she also entered the Cholistan Desert Rally in the Women’s Prepared Category, where she faced a challenging race that included hitting a tree and sustaining a painful arm injury from an unseen pothole, yet she persevered to finish and secure a podium placement.

Today, Laiba receives encouraging feedback from people and parents whose daughters aspire to enter the sport. By persisting in a male-dominated field, she feels she has successfully demonstrated that motorsports can be a viable path for other women as well.

stories.title: Indiana Fever Guard Sophie Cunningham Praises WNBA Finals MVP Gabby Williams
stories.summary:
Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham has voiced strong admiration for Gabby Williams, highlighting the player's remarkable playoff performance during a podcast discussion honoring All-Defensive Team selections and All-Stars. Cunningham emphasized that Williams' exceptional abilities were clearly demonstrated throughout the entire season and particularly in the final game, making her recent accolades thoroughly deserved.

Cunningham specifically commended Williams for her team-first attitude, describing her as an exemplary and humble teammate who conducts herself with grace. According to Cunningham, Williams consistently lets her on-court performance speak for itself while maintaining a sharp focus on what truly matters to the team's success. Her energetic presence and unselfish nature also played a crucial role in maintaining strong locker room chemistry and upholding the franchise's collective culture during her first year with Golden State.

Concluding an extraordinary season that drew attention even from NBA legend Michael Jordan, Williams and the Valkyries have cemented their place in WNBA history. Cunningham noted that Williams will continue to serve as an inspiration for younger generations through the passion and sacrifice she displays every time she steps onto the basketball court.

stories.title: Indian National Killed and New Zealander Injured in Mount Everest Helicopter Collision
stories.summary:
An aviation accident involving two helicopters in Nepal's Mount Everest region resulted in the death of an Indian national and injuries to a tourist from New Zealand. Solukhumbu district chief district officer Kaman Singh Thapa Magar stated that the collision occurred as the aircraft prepared to land within the Mount Everest base camp area. The rescue of the injured New Zealander was successfully carried out following the crash.

Operated by private companies Fishtail Air and Dynasty Air, the two helicopters served different purposes at the time of the event. A Fishtail Air representative explained that their aircraft was transporting passengers previously rescued from the Everest region when the landing crash happened, carrying both the deceased Indian tourist and the injured New Zealander. Meanwhile, a Dynasty Air spokesperson confirmed that their helicopter was exclusively loaded with cargo.

Occurring during Nepal's peak trekking season, the incident highlights the frequent use of helicopters to transport hikers and climbers across the mountainous territory. The accident follows a separate helicopter crash in the Indian Himalayan state of Uttarakhand one week prior. That prior incident involved a flight from the Hindu pilgrimage site of Badrinath to Dehradun city, resulting in the deaths of all six individuals on board, which included five passengers and the pilot, according to statements from the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority and ANI.

This event is significant due to the ongoing safety concerns surrounding helicopter operations in high-altitude Himalayan regions during heavy tourist seasons. Both incidents underscore the inherent aviation risks associated with mountain transit for tourism, rescue operations, and cargo delivery in remote terrain.

stories.title: بی بی سی اردو اب نئی موبائل ایپ پر بھی باآسانی دستیاب ہے
stories.summary:
برطانوی نشریاتی ادارے بی بی سی نے اپنی نئی موبائل ایپ لانچ کر دی ہے، جس کے ذریعے اب صارفین دنیا بھر کی علاقائی اور عالمی خبریں، تفصیلی تجزیے اور معلومات براہ راست اپنے موبائل فون یا ٹیبلٹ پر حاصل کر سکتے ہیں۔

بی بی سی اردو کا تمام مواد اب نئی بی بی سی ورلڈ سروس ایپ پر مہیا کیا گیا ہے۔ صارفین اسے اپنی ڈیوائس کے حساب سے گوگل پلے سٹور یا ایپ سٹور سے ڈاؤن لوڈ کر سکتے ہیں۔ ایپ انسٹال کرنے کے بعد ناظرین کو 'بی بی سی نیوز اردو' کے ایڈیشن کا انتخاب کرنا ہوگا، جہاں پاکستان سمیت دنیا بھر کے مختلف حصوں میں موجود بی بی سی کے نامہ نگاروں کی رپورٹس مل سکیں گی۔

واضح رہے کہ یہ ایپ برطانیہ اور امریکہ میں ڈاون لوڈ کے لیے دستیاب نہیں ہے اور اس کا کوئی انگریزی زبان کا ایڈیشن بھی اس شکل میں موجود نہیں ہے۔ اس پلیٹ فارم پر لائیو کوریج کے ساتھ ساتھ خبریں پڑھنے اور ویڈیوز دیکھنے کی سہولت بھی ایک ہی جگہ فراہم کی گئی ہے۔

بی بی سی دنیا کا ایک معروف پبلک سروس نشریاتی ادارہ ہے جو تجارتی اور سیاسی اثر و آزاد ہو کر شاہی چارٹر کے تحت کام کرتا ہے۔ اس کی ورلڈ سروس 45 مختلف زبانوں میں اپنے ناظرین کو خبریں پہنچاتی ہے اور دنیا بھر میں خودمختاری اور اعتماد کے اعتبار سے ناظرین کی پہلی پسند مانی جاتی ہے۔

stories.title: Two Policemen Guarding Anti-Polio Drive Killed in Mohmand Attack
stories.summary:
Two police officers lost their lives and a third sustained injuries during a Tuesday morning assault in Pandiyali Tehsil, located within the Mohmand district. Unidentified gunmen opened fire on a security detail tasked with protecting an anti-polio vaccination team. Two of the targeted officers died immediately at the scene from the gunfire.

Rescue 1122 emergency workers responded to the location and transported both the deceased policemen and the wounded officer to Ghallanai Hospital in Mohmand. Federal Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi issued a strong condemnation of the violence directed at the security personnel. He extended his condolences to the grieving families, honored the sacrifices of the slain officers, and wished the injured survivor a fast recovery.

Minister Naqvi stressed that officers protecting vaccination workers are dedicated to securing a healthier future for the country. He declared that assaults on police details safeguarding anti-polio initiatives are completely unacceptable and stated that the attackers will face no leniency for their actions.

The attack matters because it highlights the continuous security threats faced by medical and protection workers striving to eradicate polio in Pakistan. Safeguarding these campaigns remains a critical challenge for regional authorities combating militant violence against health workers.

stories.title: South Korean Shares Drop as Wall Street Tech Selloff Weighs on Markets
stories.summary:
South Korean financial markets experienced a downturn as persistent technology share selloffs originating on Wall Street impacted investor sentiment, despite downward pressure on global oil prices. The benchmark KOSPI index dropped 159.11 points, equating to a 2.72 percent decline, to settle at 5,699.97 by 0233 GMT. Concurrently, the South Korean won strengthened against the US dollar while benchmark bond yields decreased amid active foreign selling.

Major technology and industrial heavyweights saw notable losses during the session. Chipmaker Samsung Electronics dropped 3.17 percent, and competitor SK Hynix fell 4.14 percent. Other prominent market constituents also declined, including battery manufacturer LG Energy Solution down 3.51 percent, Hyundai Motor down 3.57 percent, sister automaker Kia Corp down 1.25 percent, and steel producer POSCO Holdings sliding 5.65 percent. Conversely, drugmaker Samsung BioLogics rose 2.18 percent. Out of 908 traded issues, 250 advanced while 624 declined, with foreign investors acting as net sellers of 811.4 billion won worth of shares.

International market factors included a 0.5 percent slip in Wall Street's S&P 500 index driven by tech sector earnings, even though US manufacturing activity showed improvement in October due to strong domestic demand. Additionally, crude oil prices dropped more than 7 percent following diplomatic talks between Iranian and Qatari officials, which fostered optimism regarding a potential resolution to the US-Israeli conflict with Iran and stabilized Middle East crude supplies.

In currency and debt markets, the South Korean won traded at 1,340.8 per dollar on the onshore settlement platform, marking a 0.39 percent increase from its prior close of 1,346.0. Year-to-date, the KOSPI has gained 35.26 percent, and the won has strengthened 7.4 percent against the dollar. Meanwhile, December futures on three-year Treasury bonds increased by 0.09 points to 103.48, with the benchmark three-year treasury bond yield falling 2.0 basis points to 3.724 percent and the 10-year yield dropping 4.5 basis points to 3.997 percent.

stories.title: Keira Knightley Discusses Humour and Moral Complexity in Return of 'Black Doves'
stories.summary:
The Netflix spy thriller "Black Doves" returns for its second season, combining high-octane action with humor and intricate, morally ambiguous characters. Speaking at the London launch event of the show's second season, 41-year-old actor Keira Knightley highlighted the unique tonal balance of the series. She noted that while the production is designed to be fun and absurd, it features deeply interesting characters who navigate complex moral dilemmas simultaneously.

The upcoming season follows Knightley's character, spy Helen Webb, as she attempts to manage a dangerous double life while her husband campaigns to become prime minister. A conspiracy targeting her handler, Mrs Reed, pulls Webb and her long-time ally Sam Young, portrayed by Ben Whishaw, into a high-stakes mission. Both Knightley and Whishaw described the new episodes as revolving around intensely stressful circumstances, with Webb striving for self-preservation and Young experiencing a near-nervous breakdown. Newcomer Ambika Mod joins the cast as an assassin assigned to assist Webb, drawn to the project by its subversion of traditional espionage tropes.

Series creator and writer Joe Barton emphasized that the appeal of the six-part series lies in audiences rooting for characters who would typically be categorized as villains. Barton remarked that viewers grow to like these figures despite their actions as mass murderers and psychopaths. The production team also celebrated the show's broader representation of regional voices, with Welsh actor Gabrielle Creevy expressing excitement for younger generations to hear authentic regional accents on a major streaming platform like Netflix.

During the launch celebrations, conversation briefly shifted to the James Bond franchise when Whishaw—known for playing the gadget master Q—shared his perspective on the film series' future. He suggested that incoming filmmakers should approach the property with boldness and freedom to reinvent it for contemporary audiences, though he noted he has not been approached to reprise his role. The second season of "Black Doves" premieres on Netflix on Thursday.

stories.title: Pakistan Cricket Board Names Shaheens Squad for Upcoming Qatar Tournament
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Cricket Board has officially revealed the fifteen-member squad for the upcoming ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. Abdul Samad has been appointed as the captain to lead the defending champions in the fifty-over competition, which is scheduled to take place in Qatar from November nineteen to November twenty-nine. The squad is placed in Group B alongside India A, Nepal, and the United Arab Emirates.

During the group stage, the Pakistan Shaheens will play their opening fixture against the United Arab Emirates on November twenty. Subsequent group fixtures include matches against India A on November twenty-two and Nepal on November twenty-four. The semi-finals are slated for November twenty-six and twenty-seven, while the tournament final will be contested on Sunday, November twenty-nine. Most matches are scheduled as day-night encounters at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium, with the exception of the opening fixture at the University of Doha Science and Technology ground.

The selected team features a robust batting lineup including Hasan Nawaz, Maaz Sadaqat, Haider Ali, Shahzaib Khan, Farhan Yousuf, and Shamyl Hussain, alongside designated wicket-keeper Rohail Nazir. The spin bowling department relies on Danish Aziz, Saad Masood, and Sufyan Moqim, while the pace attack is spearheaded by Mohammad Hasnain, Ahmed Daniyal, Akif Javed, and Muhammad Imran Randhawa.

Historically, Pakistan claimed the fifty-over title in two thousand and three in Sri Lanka by defeating India A, and secured the twenty-twenty title in a previous edition through a super-over win against Bangladesh A. Group A of the current tournament comprises Afghanistan A, Bangladesh A, Hong Kong China, and Sri Lanka A.

stories.title: Four Polio Vaccination Workers Abducted by Armed Men in Tank District
stories.summary:
Unidentified armed men have kidnapped four members of a polio vaccination team in the Shaikh Attar area of the Tank district. According to local law enforcement, the abductees have been identified as UCMO Qadeer, area in-charge Usman, Sameer, and Umair. At the time of the incident, the victims were actively performing vaccination duties in a local village.

The abduction occurred during a nationwide, week-long anti-polio vaccination campaign that commenced on November second across ninety-seven districts in various provinces. The nationwide drive aims to administer polio drops to approximately twenty-four million children under the age of five.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi expressed deep concern regarding the kidnapping of the healthcare workers and strongly condemned the incident. In response to the crisis, the governor has issued directives for immediate and effective measures to ensure the safe recovery of the abducted personnel.

Authorities are continuing their efforts to address the security situation surrounding vaccination teams deployed in the region, while local police investigate the circumstances of the kidnapping to locate the victims and apprehend the perpetrators.

stories.title: Karachi Family Harassed and Assaulted by Occupants of Double-Cabin Vehicle
stories.summary:
A viral social media video depicting a Karachi family being harassed and assaulted by individuals in a double-cabin vehicle has prompted police action. The incident occurred in North Karachi, where the occupants of the vehicle reportedly misbehaved with the family and physically attacked a male citizen.

The affected citizen filed a formal complaint at the Sir Syed Police Station, leading to the registration of a case that includes charges of rioting, assault, and other relevant offenses. According to the complainant, he, his wife, and their one-year-old son had gone out for dinner in Johar and were driving toward Nagan Chowrangi when they noticed the double-cabin vehicle following them.

The complainant stated that several men alighted from the vehicle and physically assaulted him near Nagan Chowrangi. He identified the alleged attackers as Bilawal Soomro, Umair Soomro, Hisham, Ihtisham, and Faizan, noting that they reside in the same locality. Furthermore, the complainant alleged that the suspects pulled his wife's dupatta, causing severe distress to their young child.

Following the filing of the complaint, the victim requested that the authorities pursue strict legal action against all individuals involved. Police confirmed that the investigation is actively underway to determine the exact sequence of events and fully identify the suspects responsible for the assault.

stories.title: Iranian Foreign Minister Confirms Ongoing Talks with Saudi Arabia Amid Regional Conflict
stories.summary:
Iran and Saudi Arabia are currently engaged in diplomatic talks aimed at preventing further military escalation and establishing new regional security arrangements without foreign military intervention. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi shared details of the ongoing diplomatic efforts on social media platform X, emphasizing Tehran's strategic objectives for the region.

The diplomatic engagement follows a recent visit to Tehran by top officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan, marking the first high-level contact between Iran and those three nations since August. Bilateral tensions and regional fighting intensified following the outbreak of the US-Israeli war on Iran in late February, which subsequently spread to impact Saudi Arabia and Yemen.

Riyadh stated that the high-level visits were intended to open formal negotiating channels to curb military escalation, particularly as fighting between Saudi forces and Yemen's Houthi movement intensified in recent weeks. Meanwhile, Houthi attacks on the kingdom escalated as the group advanced toward the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a vital shipping chokepoint situated opposite the Strait of Hormuz.

The ongoing conflict has also involved Houthi drone and missile strikes targeting Saudi oil facilities and airports, including Riyadh's international airport, which disrupted flights and oil exports and prompted Saudi retaliatory airstrikes in Yemen. Impoverished Yemen has remained trapped in a civil war since the Houthis forced the internationally recognized, Saudi-backed government out of Sanaa in 2014.

stories.title: وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے خیبر پختونخوا کی صورتحال کا جائزہ اجلاس طلب کر لیا
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم پاکستان شہباز شریف نے خیبر پختونخوا کے حالات کا جائزہ لینے کے لیے ایک اہم اجلاس طلب کیا ہے۔ اس مشاورتی بیٹھک میں صوبے کی مجموعی صورتحال پر غور و خوض کیا جائے گا اور وزیراعظم کو اس خطے سے متعلق مختلف فیصلوں اور ان کے نتائج پر تفصیلی بریفنگ فراہم کی جائے گی۔

ذرائع کے مطابق وزیراعظم ہاؤس میں منعقد ہونے والے اس اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء کے ساتھ ساتھ اعلیٰ عسکری حکام بھی شرکت کریں گے۔ اس کے علاوہ گورنر خیبر پختونخوا فیصل کریم کنڈی بھی خصوصی طور پر اس اجلاس میں شریک ہوں گے، جو اس سلسلے میں اسلام آباد پہنچ چکے ہیں۔

اجلاس کے حوالے سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے گورنر خیبر پختونخوا فیصل کریم کنڈی نے واضح کیا ہے کہ سہیل آفریدی کے وارنت گرفتاری سے متعلق تمام تر قانونی تقاضوں کو مکمل کیا جائے گا۔ دوسری جانب صوبائی مشیر اطلاعات ثمر ہارون بلور کی جانب سے سہیل آفریدی پر اربوں روپے کی کرپشن کے الزامات بھی عائد کیے گئے ہیں۔

اس اعلیٰ سطحی اجلاس کا بنیادی مقصد خیبر پختونخوا کے انتظامی اور سکیورٹی امور کا باریک بینی سے جائزہ لینا ہے۔ وفاقی سطح پر صوبائی صورتحال کا ادراک کرنے اور آئندہ کے لائحہ عمل کے تعین کے لیے یہ بیٹھک انتہائی اہمیت کی حامل ہے۔

stories.title: راولپنڈی میں کروڑوں روپے کے زیورات چرانے والی گھر کی ملازمہ گرفتار
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی کے علاقے میں سینتیس لاکھ روپے مالیت کے طلائی زیورات کی چوری کا ڈراپ سین ہو گیا ہے۔ پولیس نے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے گھر میں چوری کے اس واقعے میں ملوث گھر کی ملازمہ کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے، جس سے لاکھوں روپے کے زیورات بھی برآمد کر لیے گئے ہیں۔

پولیس حکام کے مطابق گرفتار ہونے والی ملزمہ چند روز قبل ہی اس گھر میں ملازمت پر رکھی گئی تھی۔ پولیس نے تمام دستیاب ذرائع کو بروئے کار لاتے ہوئے تفتیش مکمل کی اور ملزمہ کو پکڑنے میں کامیابی حاصل کی۔

پولیس کا کہنا ہے کہ مرکزی ملزمہ کی گرفتاری کے بعد اب اس کے مفرور ساتھی کی تلاش جاری ہے اور اس کی گرفتاری کے لیے مختلف مقامات پر چھاپے مارے جا رہے ہیں۔ برآمد کیے گئے تمام طلائی زیورات قانونی کارروائی کے بعد مقدمہ کے مدعی کے حوالے کر دیے گئے ہیں۔

اس کے علاوہ راولپنڈی پولیس دیگر مختلف جرائم اور امن و امان کی صورتحال سے نمٹنے کے لیے سی سی ٹی وی فوٹیج اور دیگر تکنیکی ذرائع کی مدد سے ملزمان کی تلاش اور گرفتاری کے لیے مسلسل متحرک ہے۔

stories.title: انتخابات نہ کرانے پر الیکشن کمیشن کا ایم کیو ایم پاکستان کو شوکاز نوٹس
stories.summary:
الیکشن کمیشن نے مقررہ مدت کے اندر انٹرا پارٹی انتخابات کے قانونی تقاضے پورے نہ کرنے پر متحدہ قومی موومنٹ (ایم کیو ایم) پاکستان کو باضابطہ طور پر شوکاز نوٹس جاری کر دیا ہے۔ کمیشن کے مطابق یہ نوٹس چھبیس اکتوبر دو ہزار چھبیس کو جاری کیا گیا۔

نوٹس میں کہا گیا ہے کہ سیاسی جماعت نے دی گئی توثیقی مدت یعنی پندره اکتوبر دو ہزار چھبیس تک اپنے درونِ خانہ انتخابات منعقد نہیں کیے۔ الیکشن ایکٹ دو ہزار سترہ کے تحت تمام سیاسی جماعتوں کے لیے باقاعدگی سے عہدیداران کا انتخاب کرانا اور اس کے بعد سات روز کے اندر انتخابی سرٹیفکیٹ جمع کرانا لازمی قانونی ذمہ داری ہے۔

الیکشن کمیشن نے ایم کیو ایم کو شوکاز نوٹس کا جواب داخل کرنے کے لیے چودھ دن کی مہلت دی ہے۔ ادارے نے واضح کیا ہے کہ مقررہ مدت میں تسلی بخش جواب نہ ملنے کی صورت میں قانون کے مطابق سخت کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔

کمیشن نے مزید تنبیہ کی ہے کہ پارٹی انتخابات وقت پر نہ کرانے کے باعث ایم کیو ایم آئندہ انتخابات کے لیے اپنا انتخابی نشان حاصل کرنے کی اہلیت سے محروم ہو سکتی ہے اور اس کا انتخابی نشان روکا بھی جا سکتا ہے۔

stories.title: کراچی ایئرپورٹ پر ایف آئی اے کی کارروائی، عراق جانے والے تین مسافر آف لوڈ
stories.summary:
کراچی ایئرپورٹ پر فیڈرل انویسٹی گیشن ایجنسی (ایف آئی اے) امیگریشن حکام نے ایک کارروائی کے دوران عراق جانے والے تین مسافروں کو پرواز سے اتار لیا۔ ترجمان ایف آئی اے کے مطابق یہ تمام مسافر عراق کے ورک ویزوں پر سفر کر رہے تھے اور گجرات کے ایک ایجنٹ سے چار لاکھ روپے کے عوض ای پروٹیکٹر رجسٹریشن سرٹیفکیٹس حاصل کیے تھے۔

تران نے مزید بتایا کہ جانچ پڑتال کے دوران ان مسافروں کے ای پروٹیکٹر سرٹیفکیٹس مشکوک اور جعلی ثابت ہوئے۔ ان جعلی دستاویزات میں تنخواہ، آجر کا فون نمبر اور ای میل کا اندراج نہیں تھا۔ اس کے علاوہ مسافروں کے پاس سفر کے لیے ایڈوانس ہوٹل بکنگ اور اخراجات کی مناسب رقم بھی موجود نہیں تھی۔

ح حکام کے مطابق نامکمل دستاویزات، جعلی سرٹیفکیٹس اور دیگر وجوہات کی بنا پر تینوں افراد کو آف لوڈ کیا گیا۔ یہ کارروائی مسافروں کی جانچ کے دوران سامنے آنے والی بے ضابطگیوں کے بعد عمل میں لائی گئی۔

آف لوڈ کیے جانے والے تینوں مسافروں کو مزید قانونی کارروائی اور تفتیش کے لیے اینٹی ہیومن ٹریفکنگ سرکل منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔ حکام اس معاملے میں ملوث ایجنٹ اور دیگر افراد کا سراغ لگانے کے لیے تحقیقات کر رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: South African Rand Holds Firm Amid US Trade Suspension and Elections
stories.summary:
During early trading on Tuesday, the South African currency remained relatively stable against the dollar, hovering at 16.62 as investors evaluated Washington's recent trade announcement and awaited important domestic and international political events. The US Trade Representative, Jamieson Greer, formally notified Congress that South Africa and Rwanda face suspension from the African Growth and Opportunity Act, known as AGOA, starting on January 1, 2027. This impending penalty stems from documented concerns regarding human rights, national corruption levels, and potential threats directed at American interests.

In response to the trade measure, the South African trade ministry stated late Monday that it intends to back vulnerable economic sectors while continuously pursuing commercial investments and broader financial ties with the United States. Analysts at ETM Analytics suggested that the economic fallout will likely remain milder than initial reports indicate because financial markets already accounted for the suspension beforehand, which helped cushion the currency's daily movement.

Simultaneously, financial actors are monitoring pivotal political votes, including local government elections scheduled in South Africa for Wednesday alongside midterm elections in the United States that could alter the congressional power balance. Adam Phillips from Umkhulu Treasury noted that market participants anticipated traders scaling back their financial exposure early in the day due to the divergent yet impactful nature of both democratic exercises.

Alongside currency stability, South African debt instruments showed slight vulnerability during early sessions. The benchmark government bond maturing in 2035 experienced downward pressure, with its yield increasing by 1.5 basis points to reach 8.51 percent as markets processed the overlapping geopolitical and domestic developments.

stories.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Futures Decline for Second Consecutive Session
stories.summary:
Malaysian palm oil futures experienced a downward trend for the second session in a row on Tuesday. The primary driver behind the market decrease was weaker performance from competing Dalian oils, which dragged down regional commodity valuations during early trading hours.

Despite the downward pressure originating from rival markets, certain external factors managed to cushion the losses. Specifically, firmer global crude oil prices alongside stabilizing Chicago soyoil provided limited support to prevent a steeper drop in the benchmark commodity contract.

Focusing on the specific market figures, the benchmark palm oil contract scheduled for January delivery on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange recorded a loss of 37 ringgit, translating to a 0.8 percent decrease. This placed the trading value at 4,612 ringgit, or approximately $1,133.73, per metric ton during the early trading session.

stories.title: Chicago Wheat Drops on Potential Peace Talks Between Russia and Ukraine
stories.summary:
Chicago wheat values dropped during Tuesday morning trade as market participants reacted to potential peace negotiations aimed at resolving the conflict between Russia and Ukraine. This diplomatic development raises expectations that blockaded Black Sea grain shipments could soon resume normal flow, influencing global agricultural pricing.

According to data recorded at 0234 GMT, the most active wheat contract on the Chicago Board of Trade decreased by 0.21 percent to reach $6.05-1/4 a bushel. Andrew Whitelaw of the Australian agricultural consultancy Episode 3 noted that if hostilities officially cease, the already bearish market could face heightened downward pressure due to massive amounts of pent-up Russian and Ukrainian grain supplies.

To address the conflict, US envoy Steve Witkoff announced that the United States will host delegations from both Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi on November 10-11. These upcoming discussions are intended to explore ending Moscow's military campaign, establishing post-war security agreements, and implementing local de-escalation measures.

Other agricultural commodities experienced mixed performances globally. Soybeans rebounded slightly by 0.18 percent to $12.19 a bushel following a near 11-week low, supported by US farmers harvesting 88 percent of their crop by Sunday, while corn prices slipped 0.39 percent to $4.46-1/2 a bushel alongside significant confirmed export sales to Mexico and China. Meanwhile, tightening global supplies and reduced exports from Trinidad and Tobago pushed US fertilizer costs higher, and agricultural exports from Argentina surged 157 percent year-on-year in October to reach $2.88 billion.

stories.title: پاکستان ریلویز کے مالیاتی گوشواروں کا بین الاقوامی معیار کے مطابق آڈٹ کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
لاہور میں وفاقی وزیر ریلوے محمد حنیف عباسی نے پاکستان ریلویز میں مالیاتی شفافیت، جوابدہی اور بہترین طرزِ حکمرانی کو یقینی بنانے کا اعلان کیا ہے۔ اس سلسلے میں ادارے کے مالیاتی گوشواروں کا پہلی بار بین الاقوامی مالیاتی رپورٹنگ معیارات کے تحت آڈٹ کروایا جائے گا۔ یہ اقدام مالی سال 2025-26 کے لیے اٹھایا جا رہا ہے جس کے تحت عالمی معیار کی چارٹرڈ اکاؤنٹنٹ فرم کی خدمات حاصل کی جائیں گی۔ فرم کا انتخاب مکمل میرٹ پر پبلک پروکیورمنٹ ریگولیٹری اتھارٹی کے قوانین کے مطابق عمل میں لایا جائے گا۔

تمام تر کارروائی شفافیت کو برقرار رکھنے کے لیے ای پیڈز پورٹل کے توسط سے مکمل کی جائے گی۔ یہ فیصلہ اسٹیٹ اونڈ انٹرپرائزز ایکٹ 2023ء کے تقاضوں کی روشنی میں ریلویز کے اندر مالیاتی نظم و ضبط، اندرونی کنٹرول اور ادارہ جاتی شفافیت کو مزید مضبوط بنانے کے لیے کیا گیا ہے۔ وفاقی وزیر کا کہنا ہے کہ آزادانہ آڈٹ رپورٹ ملنے کے بعد ضروری اور سخت نوعیت کے فیصلے کیے جائیں گے۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ ادارے میں بدعنوانی کا مکمل خاتمہ اور مالی معاملات میں جوابدہی حکومت کی اولین ترجیحات میں شامل ہے۔

وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف خود اس ادارے کی کارکردگی اور اصلاحاتی عمل کی نگرانی کر رہے ہیں۔ اس پوری کوشش کا مقصد پاکستان ریلویز کو مالی طور پر خود مختار، شفاف اور مستحکم بنانا ہے تاکہ وہ قومی معیشت کی بہتری میں اپنا بھرپور کردار ادا کر سکے۔ اس کے علاوہ مالیاتی شفافیت اور مؤثر نگرانی کے ذریعے عوامی وسائل کے درست اور بہتر استعمال کو بھی یقینی بنایا جائے گا تاکہ ادارے کے ایک ایک پائی کا حساب لیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: برطانیہ: بیوی کو نشہ آور ادویات دے کر ریپ کرانے والا شوہر عدالت میں پیش
stories.summary:
برطانیہ کے شہر مانچسٹر میں ایک انتہائی لرزہ خیز مقدمے کی سماعت شروع ہو گئی ہے جس میں ایک شخص پر الزام ہے کہ اس نے اپنی ساٹھ سالہ بیوی کو مسلسل نشہ آور ادویات دے کر اجنبی مردوں سے اس کا ریپ کروایا۔ استغاثہ کے مطابق یہ خاتون، جو نو برس سے کسی بھی جنسی تعلق سے لاعلم تھیں، اس گھناؤنے فعل سے بالکل بے خبر تھیں۔

عدالت کو بتایا گیا کہ متاثرہ خاتون کا شوہر اپنی بیوی کے ساتھ عام زندگی گزارنے کا ڈھونگ رچاتا رہا جبکہ درحقیقت وہ 2004 سے سٹاکپورٹ میں اپنے گھر سے اس کی بے ہوشی کی حالت میں ویڈیوز اور تصاویر آن لائن شیئر کر رہا تھا۔ پولیس نے ملزم کے موبائل فون سے دس لاکھ سے زائد ایسی فائلیں برآمد کی ہیں جو اس برے فعل کا ریکارڈ بناتی ہیں۔

مقدمے میں شوہر پہلے ہی کئی جرائم کا اعتراف کر چکا ہے، تاہم نو دیگر ملزم افراد نے الزامات سے انکار کیا ہے جن کے خلاف مانچسٹر منشل سٹریٹ کراؤن کورٹ میں سماعت جاری ہے۔ استغاثہ نے جیوری کے سامنے شواہد پیش کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ یہ ملزمان جان بوجھ کر اس خاتون کی بے ہوشی کا فائدہ اٹھاتے تھے۔

اس مقدمے کی تحقیقات اکتوبر 2025 میں اس وقت سامنے آئیں جب خفیہ تحقیقاتی صحافیوں نے ٹیلیگرام پر ایک نجی چینل کا سراغ لگایا۔ اس معاملے میں ملوث دیگر افراد میں مختلف شعبوں سے تعلق رکھنے والے افراد شامل ہیں جن پر ریپ یا اس میں سہولت کاری کے الزامات عائد کیے گئے ہیں۔

stories.title: China Yuan Set for Largest Drop as PBOC Raises RRR
stories.summary:
China’s yuan weakened significantly on Tuesday, heading toward its biggest one-day drop against the dollar in six months. The shift follows an announcement by the People’s Bank of China that it will raise the foreign exchange reserve requirement ratio by 2 percentage points, moving it from 4% to 6% effective November 15. Financial analysts and traders note that the policy change is designed to tighten dollar liquidity and temper the rapid appreciation of the yuan.

The intervention comes after the yuan climbed 0.74% in October, pushing its year-to-date gains to roughly 5% due to strong exports, trade surpluses, and corporate conversions. Zhiwei Zhang, chief economist at Pinpoint Asset Management, stated that the central bank acted to address concerns over the swift appreciation of the currency, which could negatively impact China's export-reliant economy. Following the announcement, the onshore yuan dropped to 6.6728 per dollar, its weakest level since October 23, while the offshore currency also declined.

Additionally, the People’s Bank of China lowered its daily midpoint rate for the second consecutive day to 6.7150 per dollar. Market watchers indicate that the central bank is actively managing the pace of the currency's gains ahead of a seasonal period where exporters typically convert large shares of foreign exchange earnings into yuan for year-end and Lunar New Year financial obligations.

stories.title: Australian Batsman Glenn Maxwell Retires From International Cricket
stories.summary:
Explosive Australian batsman Glenn Maxwell announced his retirement from international cricket on Tuesday after being omitted from the upcoming Twenty20 series against England. The 38-year-old previously ended his one-day international career last year and last played a Test match in 2017. Selectors overlooked Maxwell for the squad named on Monday, favoring younger players instead, following previous omissions for the T20 World Cup in Sri Lanka and a series against Bangladesh.

Speaking on the Final Word podcast, Maxwell expressed that the decision was both sad and inevitable. He mentioned that discussions with team management had been open-ended and that he understood the selection panel's focus on building for the future. Although he held a small hope for a farewell match at the Melbourne Cricket Ground against England, he accepted the direction of the national squad.

Over his career, Maxwell played 130 T20 internationals, scoring 2,897 runs at a strike rate of 154.42, which makes him Australia's third-highest run-scorer in the format behind David Warner and Aaron Finch. He also appeared in 149 ODIs and 7 Tests. Maxwell has additionally concluded his first-class career with Victoria but intends to continue playing in the Big Bash League with the Melbourne Renegades.

stories.title: US Supreme Court Allows California to Count Disputed Ballots
stories.summary:
On the eve of the US midterm elections, the Supreme Court on Monday rejected an emergency request by President Donald Trump's administration to block California from counting mail-in ballots from over 20,000 registered voters. Federal officials alleged that these individuals are likely non-US citizens. The justices denied the Department of Justice's bid just hours after it was filed, leaving the ballots eligible for counting and avoiding significant uncertainty in the populous Democratic stronghold state.

The brief, one-sentence order included no explanation, and no justice publicly dissented from the ruling. The decision marks another setback for the administration, which filed a federal lawsuit on October 15 claiming California violated a 1996 federal law and the Constitution’s Supremacy Clause by failing to prevent noncitizen voting. California officials maintained that the state's safeguards against ineligible voting are robust and that the federal lawsuit aimed to disenfranchise thousands of citizens based on flawed data and vague accusations.

Lower courts had previously refused the administration's demands. US District Judge David Carter in Los Angeles denied the request on October 28, criticizing the federal government for attempting to interfere with state election procedures on the eve of the vote. Subsequently, the 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals also declined to block the ballots on Friday. California represents a critical battleground with 52 seats in the House of Representatives, where Democrats require a net gain of four seats to secure a majority.

stories.title: Australian Shares Rise After Reserve Bank Hikes Interest Rates to 4.85%
stories.summary:
Australian financial markets recovered following a decision by the central bank to elevate borrowing costs. The S&P/ASX 200 index increased by 0.2 percent to reach 8,872.30 by 0345 GMT, reversing an earlier decline of 0.1 percent prior to the announcement.

The Reserve Bank of Australia increased its primary cash rate to 4.85 percent, marking a nearly 18-year high following its November policy meeting. Officials stated they would take necessary measures to return inflation to target levels, while omitting language regarding potential future increases. This year's total tightening of 125 basis points has surpassed previous easing measures from 2025.

Sector performances varied as financials climbed 0.4 percent, with Commonwealth Bank of Australia advancing 1.5 percent. Real estate and consumer discretionary shares grew by 1 percent and 0.5 percent respectively, while mining corporations BHP and Rio Tinto each rose around 0.2 percent on higher copper prices. Meanwhile, airline stocks surged due to a 7 percent drop in oil prices, sending Qantas Airways up 6.3 percent and Virgin Australia up 7.7 percent.

Conversely, falling crude prices caused a 3.2 percent drop in energy stocks. Woodside Energy and Santos fell by 3.4 percent and 2 percent respectively. In New Zealand, the S&P/NZX 50 index remained stable at 13,700.02.

stories.title: پنجاب اسمبلی کی پبلک اکاؤنٹس کمیٹی کا تمام ہاؤسنگ سوسائٹیز کا ریکارڈ طلب
stories.summary:
لاہور میں پنجاب اسمبلی کی پبلک اکاؤنٹس کمیٹی ون نے صوبہ بھر میں موجود تمام قانونی اور غیر قانونی ہاؤسنگ سوسائٹیز کی مکمل تفصیلات طلب کرلی ہیں۔ کمیٹی نے صوبے کے تمام اضلاع کے ڈپٹی کمشنرز کو ہدایت جاری کی ہے کہ وہ مقررہ مدت یعنی 60 دن کے اندر اپنے اپنے اضلاع میں قائم ہاؤسنگ سوسائٹیز کا تمام ریکارڈ جمع کرائیں۔ اس کے ساتھ ہی غیر قانونی سوسائٹیز کے قیام کے معاملے میں سرکاری اداروں کی مبینہ غفلت کا جائزہ لے کر ذمہ داران کا تعین کرنے کی بھی ہدایت کی گئی ہے۔

کمیٹی نے سینیئر ممبر بورڈ آف ریونیو، سیکرٹری بلدیات اور سیکرٹری ہاؤسنگ کو بھی اس سلسلے میں تمام تفصیلات پیش کرنے کا کہا ہے۔ متعلقہ حکام سے یہ سوال بھی کیا گیا ہے کہ پنجاب میں کل کتنی ہاؤسنگ سوسائٹیز ہیں، جن میں قانونی اور غیر قانونی کی تعداد کتنی ہے اور غیر قانونی سوسائٹیز کے قیام میں کن اداروں کی کوتاہی یا غفلت شامل رہی ہے۔ اس ضمن میں اب تک کی جانے والی کارروائیوں اور سوسائٹیز کے خلاف اٹھائے گئے اقدامات کا ریکارڈ بھی طلب کیا گیا ہے۔

پبلک اکاؤنٹس کمیٹی نے قانونی ہاؤسنگ سوسائٹیز میں پلاٹس کی فائلوں کی خرید و فروخت کے طریقہ کار پر بھی شدید تحفظات کا اظہار کیا۔ کمیٹی نے یہ سوال اٹھایا ہے کہ پانچ ہزار کنال اراضی پر قائم کسی سوسائٹی میں بیس ہزار پلاٹس کی فائلیں کیسے فروخت کی جا سکتی ہیں۔ کمیٹی نے منظور شدہ اراضی سے زائد پلاٹس کی فائلیں بیچنے سے متاثر ہونے والے شہریوں کی داد رس کے لیے کیے جانے والے اقدامات کی رپورٹ بھی طلب کی ہے۔

stories.title: South African Coach Prince and Wicketkeeper Verreynne Reprimanded by ICC
stories.summary:
South African batting coach Ashwell Prince and wicketkeeper Kyle Verreynne faced formal sanctions from cricket's governing body following an incident during a Test match against Australia at Newlands. Both individuals received reprimands and added demerit points to their records for displaying dissent toward the match officials.

The penalty stemmed from an event on the third day of the third test when batter Marques Ackerman attempted to challenge a caught decision. Umpires Richard Illingworth and Richard Kettleborough informed Ackerman that he had exceeded the mandatory 15-second allowance to request a review.

Following the ruling, Prince verbally confronted the umpires, arguing that Ackerman had indicated his intention to review within the permitted timeframe. Simultaneously, Verreynne, who was acting in a 12th-man capacity rather than playing, instructed Ackerman to stay on the playing field and delayed his departure.

Both staff members were found to have violated Article 2.8 of the International Cricket Council Code of Conduct for Players and Player Support Personnel. Each received one demerit point, bringing them closer to potential suspension thresholds under regulations regarding repeated infractions within a 24-month period. South Africa ultimately won the match by 176 runs to secure a 2-1 series victory and claim the top position in the world test rankings.

stories.title: بھارت میں سفر کرنے والے برطانوی جوڑے نے رکشہ برطانیہ منگوا لیا
stories.summary:
برطانیہ سے بھارت کی سیر پر آنے والے ایک جوڑے نے اپنے پسندیدہ آٹو رکشے سے محبت کی انوکھی مثال قائم کرتے ہوئے اسے اپنے آبائی ملک بھجوانے کا فیصلہ کیا۔ ہیلن اور مک نامی برطانوی شہریوں نے بھارت میں اپنے 75 روز کے طویل سفر کے دوران سرخ اور سیاہ رنگ کے ایک رکشے پر چار ہزار دو اٹھارہ کلومیٹر کا سفر طے کیا۔ اس دوران انہوں نے آگرہ، تاج محل سمیت ملک کے مختلف سیاحتی مقامات اور شہروں کی سیر کی۔

اس جوڑے نے اپنے سفر میں استعمال ہونے والے اس رکشے کا نام پیار سے 'ٹمی دی ٹن کین' رکھا تھا۔ انہوں نے رکشے کے اگلے حصے پر کارٹون کی طرح کی آنکھیں اور ایک مسکراتا ہوا چہرہ بھی بنوایا تھا تاکہ اسے مزید دلکش بنایا جا سکے۔ جب ان کا بھارت کا سفر تمام ہوا تو وہ اپنے اس خاص رکشے سے اتنے مانوس ہو چکے تھے کہ اسے وہیں چھوڑنے پر آمادہ نہیں ہوئے، اور اسے بحری جہاز کے ذریعے برطانیہ منتقل کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا۔

تقریباً چھ ماہ کے طویل انتظار کے بعد آخر کار یہ رکشہ 23 اکتوبر کو لندن کی بندرگاہ پر بحفاظت پہنچ گیا۔ اس برطانوی جوڑے کی اس انوکھی کہانی نے لوگوں کی توجہ حاصل کی ہے، جو اپنے یادگار سفر کی نشانی کو اپنے ساتھ اپنے ملک لے جانے میں کامیاب رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: All-Rounder Glenn Maxwell Announces Retirement from International and Domestic Cricket
stories.summary:
Victorian all-rounder Glenn Maxwell has confirmed his departure from international competition and red-ball domestic cricket. Known as "The Big Show," the 38-year-old athlete stated his choice was driven by the necessity to manage his physical condition for the remaining tournaments of his career.

Maxwell concluded an international career spanning 149 one-day internationals, 130 Twenty20 internationals, and seven test matches. His aggressive batting style and unorthodox strokeplay contributed to Australia's victories in the 50-over World Cups in 2015 and 2023, as well as the T20 World Cup in 2021. Throughout his career, he accumulated 3,990 ODI runs, 2,897 T20 runs, and claimed 128 short-format wickets with his off-spin bowling.

The announcement followed the exclusion of Maxwell from Australia's upcoming squad to face England at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, effectively ending his aspirations for a farewell match on home soil. While he previously retired from one-day internationals last year, his final international appearance occurred against Oman at the T20 World Cup in Sri Lanka in February.

stories.title: Massive Ticket Demand Recorded for 2027 Men's Cricket World Cup Clashes
stories.summary:
Organizers of the upcoming Men's Cricket World Cup reported massive public interest as ticket applications opened for the multi-nation tournament. The event is scheduled to run from October 2 to November 21 across co-hosts South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia.

A high volume of interest focused on the group-stage fixture between India and Pakistan, which attracted nearly 8.4 million ticket applications. The arch-rivals are scheduled to play at The Wanderers in Johannesburg on October 10, 2027. The tournament final, slated for the same 34,000-capacity venue, attracted nearly eight million requests.

Overall demand for the 14-team competition surpassed 120 million total requests. Nearly three million supporters from 193 countries submitted applications through the ballot window, which remains available to the public until November 21.

stories.title: Midterm Elections Determine Control of Congress and Trump's Agenda
stories.summary:
American voters are participating in Tuesday's midterm elections to decide the balance of power in Congress for the final two years of President Donald Trump's second term. Polls and nonpartisan analysts indicate that Democrats are favored to capture the House of Representatives, while the outcome for the Senate remains closely contested across nearly ten states. Historically, the sitting president's party tends to lose ground in Congress during midterm cycles, and Trump currently faces low approval ratings driven by voter discontent over domestic costs tied to a conflict with Iran and sweeping tariff policies. Republicans have sought to energize their base through numerous rallies, portraying Democratic candidates as extreme, whereas voters have primarily focused on economic affordability.

All 435 House seats and 35 of the 100 Senate seats are up for election, though only a fraction of these races are considered competitive. Democrats need to gain a net of three House seats and four Senate seats to secure majorities in both chambers. A Democratic-led Congress could initiate investigations into the administration and block key presidential appointments, including potential Supreme Court vacancies. Democrats are defending existing seats while targeting states that previously voted heavily for Trump, such as Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, Ohio, South Carolina, and Texas, where polls show tight margins.

Several individual senate races have drawn significant attention and controversy. In Michigan, progressive Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, 42, is facing Republican former US Representative Mike Rogers, 63, in a battle that recently saw an endorsement of Rogers by former Democratic primary rival Haley Stevens. Meanwhile, the Alaska race involves scrutiny over allegations that Democratic candidate Mary Peltola's campaign recruited a third candidate sharing opponent Dan Sullivan's name, prompting a federal criminal probe and unsuccessful legal challenges from the Trump administration. In Texas, Democratic candidate James Talarico is challenging Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton, 63, who has been supported by major financial backing from Elon Musk. Other competitive Senate contests are taking place in Kansas, Maine, Iowa, Nebraska, Ohio, and South Carolina.

In the House, 47 races are viewed as competitive, requiring Democrats to win a modest share of these contests if other outcomes follow predictions. Republican efforts to redraw districts to secure safer margins have yielded mixed results. Alongside federal contests, voters will decide three dozen gubernatorial races, numerous state legislative battles, and various ballot measures addressing topics such as abortion rights and taxes.

stories.title: European Nations Launch First Multinational Ukraine Support Force Exercise in Poland
stories.summary:
A contingent of 2,800 troops from 10 European countries is gathering in Poland this month to conduct the inaugural field exercise of the Multinational Force – Ukraine (MNF-U). Established in 2025 and jointly led by France and the United Kingdom, the initiative is designed to support the Ukrainian military, safeguard Ukrainian airspace, and help restore economic activity in the Black Sea once a ceasefire is reached. The force operates independently of NATO and has minimal US involvement, maintaining an operational headquarters in Paris. The upcoming deployment, officially named Koalicja, is scheduled to run from November 9 to 22 in southeastern Poland near the town of Nowa Deba, roughly 100 kilometers west of the Ukrainian border.

The exercise is intended to test the operational readiness, deployment speed, and coordination of land, sea, and air elements from participating nations, which include Belgium, Estonia, Germany, France, Lithuania, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain, Sweden, and the UK. France is contributing the largest contingent with 1,100 soldiers, while the UK is sending 300 troops. Co-led by French General Armel Dirou and British Lieutenant General Tom Bateman, the drills will primarily utilize light equipment such as drones for anti-drone and self-defense training rather than heavy weaponry like tanks. Concurrently, Turkey will direct a maritime simulation stretching from Istanbul to evaluate preparedness for future mine-clearing operations in the Black Sea.

Organizers emphasize that the MNF-U is strictly non-offensive and is not structured as a peacekeeping or ceasefire-monitoring mission. Instead, its purpose is to provide reassurance, assist in the regeneration of Ukraine's armed forces, and enhance long-term deterrence against potential future aggression. British Defence Minister Wes Streeting and Lieutenant General Bateman both stressed that the force represents a tangible capability prepared to deploy immediately following the cessation of hostilities. While the exercise aims to demonstrate logistical efficiency and interoperability among the allied forces, it carries potential diplomatic risks by drawing scrutiny from Moscow as the ongoing war approaches its five-year milestone.

stories.title: NVIDIA Introduces RTX Spark Platform for Slim Windows Laptops
stories.summary:
NVIDIA has unveiled RTX Spark, a new hardware and software category aimed at integrating advanced graphics, high-performance computing, and local artificial intelligence capabilities into slim Windows laptops. Designed for creators, developers, gamers, and general users, these devices feature up to 128GB of unified memory—a shared, high-speed workspace connecting the processor and graphics processor. By running AI models and personal agents locally on the device rather than relying exclusively on cloud infrastructure, RTX Spark aims to reduce latency, lower cloud reliance, and enhance data privacy for everyday tasks and demanding workflows.

For gamers, RTX Spark laptops eliminate the traditional compromise between portability and performance by delivering gameplay at 1440p resolution and exceeding 100 frames per second in a slim form factor. The hardware supports ray-traced lighting for realistic visual effects, DLSS technology to boost performance and sharpness using AI, and NVIDIA Reflex to minimize input delay. This enables users to handle high-end gaming on the same machine used for daily productivity without needing a separate desktop rig.

Content creators and editors can utilize the laptops to execute resource-intensive tasks away from a traditional studio setup. Video editors can work directly with 12K footage on location, 3D designers can manage massive scenes previously restricted to heavy workstations, and photographers benefit from applications like Adobe Photoshop and Premiere Pro being rebuilt by Adobe specifically for RTX Spark to double performance speeds in AI and graphics tasks. Additionally, local AI integration allows students, professionals, and developers to automate routine tasks, summarize documents, and run machine learning models directly on the device.

These slim laptops are manufactured by major PC vendors including ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, and MSI, offering all-day battery life alongside high-performance displays. The localized architecture ensures that users can execute complex workloads—from local code debugging to automated file organization—entirely on their own hardware with faster response times.

stories.title: Alaska Voters Unfazed by Controversy Surrounding Tight Senate Race
stories.summary:
Voters braving near-freezing temperatures in Anchorage, Alaska, to cast early ballots showed little concern regarding a political controversy involving Democratic Senate candidate Mary Peltola. Peltola, locked in a competitive race against Republican incumbent Senator Dan Sullivan that could impact control of the US Congress, faced allegations reported by The New York Times that her campaign helped recruit a third candidate sharing her opponent's name to create voter confusion. While political observers and President Donald Trump reacted sharply to the revelations, many local voters expressed a sense of indifference toward the tactic. Independent voter Dale Brown described the maneuver as immoral but technically legal, noting that similar strategies have been employed by Republicans elsewhere, and stated that the controversy would not alter his vote against inflation under the Trump administration.

The Trump administration has sought to challenge the election results preemptively and launched a federal criminal investigation following the report, though a federal judge recently rejected an initial bid to block the process. Despite receiving a heavy volume of campaign flyers and advertisements addressing the situation, voters noted that the ballot clearly distinguishes the incumbent senator from the independent candidate through party labels and descriptive tags. Polling station volunteers and local residents observed that most voters appear clear on how to differentiate the candidates, viewing the scandal as a distraction from core policy debates.

Interviews with Alaskans revealed that primary concerns centered around economic pressures, particularly inflation driven by federal policies and fuel costs, which heavily impact the remote state due to its reliance on shipping. Other voters highlighted local environmental issues, such as declining salmon populations and the management of oil resources. Surgical technologist Zara Oakley characterized the controversy surrounding Peltola as a distractive tactic meant to divert attention from the high stakes of the election, noting widespread local dissatisfaction with Trump as a key factor driving the competitive nature of the race in the traditionally conservative state.

stories.title: Pakistan Cricket Board Names Shaheens Squad for Rising Stars Asia Cup
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Cricket Board has announced a 15-member Pakistan Shaheens squad for the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026, with Maaz Sadaqat and Hasan Nawaz securing their places in the team. Abdul Samad has been appointed as captain to lead the squad through the 50-over tournament, which is scheduled to take place in Qatar from November 19 to 29. The Shaheens enter the competition as the defending champions of the previous 50-over edition held in Sri Lanka in 2023, where they defeated India A by 128 runs in the final. Pakistan also hold the title for the T20 version of the tournament after beating Bangladesh A in a Super Over.

The eight-team competition is divided into two groups, placing Pakistan in Group B alongside India A, Nepal, and the United Arab Emirates. Group A consists of Afghanistan A, Bangladesh A, Hong Kong China, and Sri Lanka A. Pakistan will begin their campaign against the UAE on November 20 at the University of Doha Science and Technology ground. Their subsequent group matches include a high-profile fixture against India A on November 22 and a match against Nepal on November 24, with these remaining group fixtures hosted at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium as day-night encounters.

Captain Abdul Samad will anchor a batting lineup featuring Maaz Sadaqat, Hasan Nawaz, Haider Ali, Shahzaib Khan, Farhan Yousuf, and Shamyl Hussain, alongside Rohail Nazir as the designated wicket-keeper. The squad's spin attack relies on left-arm spin all-rounder Danish Aziz, leg-spinner Saad Masood, and Sufyan Moqim. Meanwhile, the pace department will be spearheaded by Mohammad Hasnain, supported by Ahmed Daniyal, Akif Javed, and Muhammad Imran Randhawa. Ahmed Daniyal previously played an instrumental role in helping the Shaheens secure the prior T20 title against Bangladesh A.

Following the group stage, the semi-finals are scheduled for November 26 and 27, culminating in the final match on November 29. Pakistan aims to successfully defend their 50-over crown against an competitive field of emerging regional sides. The tournament highlights significant encounters in the group stage, most notably the much-anticipated clash between Pakistan and India A.

stories.title: US Judge Temporarily Blocks Administration Plan on Noncitizen Voting Lists
stories.summary:
A federal judge in Washington, DC, issued a temporary order barring the Trump administration from moving forward with a controversial initiative aimed at curbing noncitizen voting. US District Judge Tanya Chutkan prohibited the Department of Justice and the Department of Homeland Security from transmitting lists of registered voters suspected of being noncitizens to state election officials. Furthermore, the ruling blocks the administration from pressing state authorities to segregate or withhold those specific ballots until citizenship status is verified. Critics argue the initiative threatens to disenfranchise eligible voters and improperly encroaches on state election management.

The legal challenge arose after the administration ramped up pressure on election officials in states like California and Washington by demanding they exclude ballots from individuals flagged on federal noncitizen lists. Plaintiffs, including voting rights and privacy advocates, filed suit alleging violations of the Privacy Act of 1974, which limits federal disclosure of sensitive personal data. In defense, the Justice Department maintained its letters were standard enforcement of federal bans on noncitizen voting and argued the communications did not constitute a formal policy reviewable by federal courts. However, Judge Chutkan, an appointee of former President Barack Obama, expressed concern that the administration's data might be unreliable, creating a genuine risk of disenfranchising lawfully registered voters.

The ruling adds to a complex landscape of legal disputes surrounding federal authority over elections ahead of the November 3 midterms, where Republicans are working to maintain congressional majorities. In a separate legal track, a panel of the 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals recently cleared the government to threaten state and local officials with prosecution for noncompliance regarding alleged noncitizen voting, though Chutkan is not bound by that decision. Other federal judges and appellate bodies have similarly pushed back against the administration's demands, including a San Francisco judge who ordered the Justice Department to halt threats of prosecution against local election officials.

The Supreme Court also addressed related election disputes, swiftly rejecting an emergency request from the Trump administration on the eve of the midterms. The high court declined to block California from counting mail-in ballots from more than 20,000 registered voters whom federal officials alleged were likely non-US citizens. While noncitizen voting is illegal and statistically exceedingly rare, President Donald Trump has repeatedly accused states of facilitating the practice, linking it to unproven claims regarding his 2020 election loss.

stories.title: Tenerife Striker Jesus de Miguel Dies Following On-Field Collision
stories.summary:
Jesus de Miguel, a thirty-year-old striker for Spanish second division club CD Tenerife, passed away on Tuesday following a severe on-field collision during a match against FC Andorra at the Heliodoro Rodriguez Lopez stadium. The incident occurred near the end of the game when the teams were tied at 2-2, after Equatorial Guinea international goalkeeper Jesus Owono rushed out of his goal to clear the ball and fouled De Miguel in the middle of the pitch. Owono received a red card, and the match was subsequently abandoned. 

Spanish media reported that De Miguel suffered a cardiac arrest on the pitch and was successfully resuscitated before being rushed to the hospital and placed in intensive care. His club later reported that his neurological condition had worsened prior to his tragic passing at 8:00 am. De Miguel had joined Tenerife in the summer of 2025 from Castellon, having previously played for clubs including Leganes at the youth level and Unionistas de Salamanca, and helped his team achieve promotion to the second division. 

The tragedy sent shockwaves through the Spanish football community, prompting heartfelt tributes from various clubs and figures. Gerard Pique, majority shareholder of Andorra and a former Barcelona defender, expressed deep sorrow on social media, while clubs like Real Madrid, Barcelona, Atletico Madrid, and Espanyol offered condolences. Real Madrid observed a minute of silence during their training session, and French forward Kylian Mbappe shared his grief online. 

In response to the tragedy, the Royal Spanish Football Federation postponed Tuesday matches in the Copa del Rey and Copa de la Reina as a gesture of respect and solidarity. High-ranking figures, including La Liga chief Javier Tebas and Spanish sports minister Milagros Tolon, also publicly shared their grief and offered support to the player's grieving family, friends, teammates, and supporters of CD Tenerife.

stories.title: کراچی: ڈاکس کے قریب ٹریفک حادثے میں پولیس اہلکار جاں بحق ہو گیا
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے ڈاکس میں ٹریفک کے ایک دردناک حادثے کے نتیجے میں ایک پولیس اہلکار جان کی بازی ہار گیا۔ ایس ایچ او ڈاکس وقار قیصر کے مطابق سلطان آباد انٹیلیجنس کالونی کے قریب ہائی روف گاڑی میں ایک پولیس اہلکار اپنے دوست کے ہمراہ سفر کر رہا تھا کہ اچانک گاڑی کا ٹائی راڈ ٹوٹ گیا۔ ٹائی راڈ ٹوٹ جانے کے باعث ہائی روف بے قابو ہو گئی اور اپنا توازن کھو بیٹھی، جس کے بعد وہ سڑک کے فٹ پاتھ سے جا ٹکرائی۔

اس خوفناک حادثے کے نتیجے میں گاڑی کے اندر موجود پولیس اہلکار شدید زخمی ہو کر جاں بحق ہو گیا جبکہ اس کے ساتھ موجود دوست کو معمولی چوٹیں آئیں۔ واقعے کی اطلاع ملنے پر پولیس اہلکار کی لاش کو ایدھی ایمبولینس کے ذریعے فوری طور پر سول اسپتال کے ٹراما سینٹر منتقل کر دیا گیا۔ جاں بحق ہونے والے اہلکار کی شناخت تیس سالہ سمیع ولد اعجاز کے نام سے کی گئی ہے۔

پولیس کے مطابق جاں بحق ہونے والا اہلکار آرٹلری میدان تھانے کا رہائشی تھا اور اس کی تعیناتی ایک تربیتی سینٹر میں تھی۔ حادثے کے اس واقعے نے ایک قیمتی جان ضائع کر دی جبکہ پولیس حکام نے معاملے کی مزید کارروائی شروع کر دی ہے۔

stories.title: Indian National Killed and Three Injured in Nepal Helicopter Collision
stories.summary:
A 47-year-old Indian national lost his life and another passenger sustained injuries when two helicopters collided while landing in Nepal's Solukhumbu district on Tuesday. According to a statement released by Nepal Police, the accident occurred around 8:11 am local time at Pheriche, located within Ward 4 of the Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality. The involved aircraft were operated by Fishtail Air and Air Dynasty as they approached the landing site along the route to the Mount Everest Base Camp, roughly 150 kilometers northeast of Kathmandu.

District Police Office officials identified the deceased victim as Vasanth Kumar Balaramaramadu, an Indian national who was traveling aboard the Fishtail Air helicopter. Another passenger on the same flight, 49-year-old New Zealand resident of Indian origin Shailesh Krishna Patel, suffered injuries in the crash. Patel was promptly evacuated from the scene by a Prabhu Helicopter and airlifted to Mediciti Hospital in Kathmandu for medical attention.

The pilots of both aircraft—Rabindra Prajapati of Fishtail Air and Prajwal KC of Dynasty Air—were also injured during the collision. They were subsequently transported to Kathmandu to receive further treatment for their injuries. Meanwhile, the body of the deceased victim, Balaramaramadu, was transferred to a hospital located in Lukla.

Authorities have stated that the exact total number of passengers aboard the two helicopters at the moment of impact remains unconfirmed. Nepal Police are actively investigating the incident and gathering additional details to understand the full circumstances surrounding the collision.

stories.title: عالمی اور مقامی مارکیٹوں میں سونے کی قیمتیں مستحکم، چاندی سستی
stories.summary:
عالمی اور مقامی صرافہ مارکیٹوں میں سونے کے نرخ بغیر کسی تبدیلی کے برقرار رہے ہیں جبکہ چاندی کی قیمتوں میں کمی ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔ بین الاقوامی بلین مارکیٹ میں فی اونس سونا 3 ہزار 896 ڈالر کی سطح پر مستحکم رہا ہے۔ اسی طرح مقامی مارکیٹوں میں بھی منگل کے روز فی تولہ سونا 4 لاکھ 12 ہزار 136 روپے اور فی دس گرام سونا 3 لاکھ 53 ہزار 340 روپے پر برقرار رہا۔

اس کے برعکس عالمی مارکیٹ میں فی اونس چاندی کی قیمت میں 1 ڈالر 20 سینٹس کی کمی واقع ہوئی ہے جس کے بعد اس کے نرخ 48 ڈالر 90 سینٹس پر آ گئے ہیں۔ اس بین الاقوامی کمی کے اثرات مقامی صرافہ بازاروں پر بھی پڑے اور فی تولہ چاندی 120 روپے سستی ہو کر 5 ہزار 368 روپے کی سطح پر آ گئی۔

مزید برآں، مقامی مارکیٹ میں فی دس گرام چاندی کی قیمت میں بھی 103 روپے کی کمی دیکھی گئی، جس کے بعد اس کے نئے نرخ 4 ہزار 602 روپے ہو گئے ہیں۔ چاندی کی قیمتوں میں یہ کمی عالمی مارکیٹ میں ہونے والی گراوٹ کی وجہ سے سامنے آئی ہے۔ صرافہ بازار میں سونے کے نرخ برقرار رہنے سے خریداروں اور تاجروں میں استحکام دیکھا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: لاہور کے علاقے کاہنہ میں شوہر نے بیوی اور ڈیڑھ سالہ بچے پر تیزاب پھینک دیا
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے کاہنہ میں گھریلو تنازع اور کام نہ کرنے کے الزام پر ایک شخص نے مبینہ طور پر اپنی دوسری بیوی اور ڈیڑھ سالہ معصوم بچے پر تیزاب پھینک دیا۔ اس دلخراش واقعے کے نتیجے میں خاتون اور بچہ شدید متاثر ہوئے جبکہ خاتون کے سوتیلے بیٹے کو بھی معمولی زخم آئے۔

پولیس کے مطابق ملزم انصاف علی نے دو شادیاں کر رکھی تھیں اور اس کا اپنی دوسری بیوی کے ساتھ جھگڑا چل رہا تھا۔ واقعہ اس وقت پیش آیا جب خاتون روہی نالے کے قریب فیکٹری سے اپنے گھر واپس جا رہی تھی، اس دوران ملزم نے ان پر تیزاب پھینکا اور موقع سے فرار ہو گیا۔

تیزاب حملے کے نتیجے میں خاتون کی گردن، کمر اور دونوں ٹانگیں جھلس گئیں جبکہ ڈیڑھ سالہ بچے کا دایاں بازو بھی متاثر ہوا۔ واقعے کی ایف آئی آر درج کر کے پولیس نے فوری کارروائی کی اور ملزم کو فیصل آباد سے گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔

پولیس کی جانب سے ملزم کے خلاف قانونی کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے جبکہ متاثرہ افراد کو طبی امداد کے لیے اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا تھا۔ قانون نافذ کرنے والے ادارے اس معاملے کے تمام پہلوؤں کا جائزہ لے رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: Thai Baht Holds Steady Against US Dollar During Tuesday Trading
stories.summary:
The Thai baht maintained a stable position against the US dollar during Tuesday's trading sessions in Bangkok. According to data provided by LSEG, the currency closed its previous session at a rate of 33.7025 per dollar.

At 0225 GMT on Tuesday, the baht showed a marginal increase of 0.01%, trading at 33.70 against the dollar. Throughout the early part of the session, the currency fluctuated within a narrow band, recording a low of 33.705 and a high of 33.790 relative to the US dollar.

stories.title: نیوزی لینڈ کے بیٹر ڈیرل مچل کی شاندار کارکردگی اور ریکارڈ
stories.summary:
نیوزی لینڈ کے مڈل آرڈر بیٹر ڈیرل مچل نے ون ڈے کرکٹ میں اپنی بہترین کارکردگی کی بدولت بھارتی بیٹرز شبمن گل، ویرات کوہلی اور کے ایل راہول کے لیے سخت مقابلہ پیدا کر دیا ہے۔ رواں دہائی میں 2 ہزار سے زائد رنز اور 55 سے زیادہ کی اوسط رکھنے والے چار نمایاں بیٹرز میں واحد غیر بھارتی کھلاڑی ڈیرل مچل ہیں، جن کی اوسط 57.36 ہے۔ اس فہرست میں شبمن گل 66.01 کی اوسط کے ساتھ پہلے نمبر پر ہیں۔

مچل روایتی انداز کے بجائے اپنی جارحانہ اور طاقتور بیٹنگ کی وجہ سے جانے جاتے ہیں، جس سے حریف بولرز مشکلات کا شکار ہوتے ہیں۔ اپنے کیریئر کے آغاز میں انہیں اسپن بولنگ کھیلنے میں مشکلات کا سامنا تھا، لیکن مسلسل محنت اور نئے شاٹس پر عبور حاصل کر کے انہوں نے اس کمزوری پر قابو پا لیا۔ انہوں نے رواں دہائی میں اسپنرز کے خلاف آگے بڑھ کر 217 رنز جبکہ سوئپ اور ریورس سوئپ کے ذریعے 335 رنز اسکور کیے ہیں۔

بھارت کے خلاف ان کا ریکارڈ بالخصوص شاندار ہے جہاں انہوں نے اپنی 9 میں سے 4 سنంచరీలు اسکور کی ہیں۔ جنوری کے مہینے میں انہوں نے لگاتار دو اننگز میں 131 ناٹ آؤٹ اور 137 رنز بنا کر نیوزی لینڈ کو تاریخ میں پہلی بار بھارت میں دو طرفہ ون ڈے سیریز جتوانے میں کلیدی کردار ادا کیا۔ اب ایک بار پھر نیوزی لینڈ اور بھارت کی ٹیمیں آمنے سامنے ہیں اور سب کی توجہ مچل کی کارکردگی پر مرکوز ہے۔

stories.title: Gold Prices Dip Amid US Midterms and Softer Oil Markets
stories.summary:
Gold prices moved lower on Tuesday following a more than two percent surge in the previous session. Spot gold dropped 0.5 percent to $3,926.52 per ounce by 0353 GMT, while US gold futures for December delivery decreased by 0.8 percent to $3,936.30 per ounce. This downward movement followed a prior session rebound from a one-year low reached on Friday.

The recent price action was influenced by softer oil markets that eased inflation concerns, alongside investor caution ahead of the US midterm elections taking place later in the day. According to Tim Waterer, chief market analyst at KCM Trade, gold remains in a consolidation phase and is currently traded as a high-liquidity asset to cover losses and margin calls in other sectors, rather than acting as a traditional safe haven.

Geopolitical developments also played a role as Tehran stated that communication with the United States to end an eight-month war was ongoing following altered proposals from Qatari mediators. Meanwhile, oil prices dropped over seven percent on Monday, though energy prices remain elevated overall, fueling expectations that the Federal Reserve will maintain higher interest rates for a longer duration.

Traders currently estimate a 74 percent chance of a central bank rate hike in December, based on CME's FedWatch tool. Market participants are monitoring the US midterm elections because a potential Democratic sweep could complicate the AI data-centre build-up and the wider tech sector, potentially causing further spillover effects into gold as market positions are trimmed.

Among other precious metals affected by market movements, spot silver slipped 1.8 percent to $49.71 per ounce, platinum dropped 0.2 percent to $1,446.80 per ounce, and palladium dipped 1.4 percent to $953.64 per ounce.

stories.title: کراچی: نیو کراچی انڈسٹریل ایریا کی فیکٹری سے نوجوان کی پھندا لگی لاش برآمد
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے نیو کراچی انڈسٹریل ایریا میں سیکٹر 12 ڈی کے قریب واقع دھاگے کی ایک فیکٹری سے اٹھارہ سالہ نوجوان کی پھندا لگی لٹکی ہوئی لاش ملی ہے۔ اطلاع ملتے ہی پولیس اور کرائم سین یونٹ فوری طور پر موقع پر پہنچ گئے۔

پولیس کے مطابق متوفی کی شناخت محرم ولد غلام مصطفیٰ کے نام سے ہوئی ہے جو گزشتہ تین سال سے مذکورہ دھاگے کی فیکٹری میں بطور مشین آپریٹر فرائض انجام دے رہا تھا۔ موقع پر پہنچ کر قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں نے ضروری شواہد اکٹھے کیے اور لاش کو ضابطے کی کارروائی کے لیے عباسی شہید اسپتال منتقل کر دیا۔

پولیس حکام نے ابتدائی طور پر اس واقعے کو خودکشی قرار دیا ہے اور اس سلسلے میں مزید تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔ پولیس کی جانب سے یہ جاننے کی کوشش کی جا رہی ہے کہ اس واقعے کے محرکات کیا تھے۔

اس واقعے کی تحقیقات کے ذریعے نوجوان کی موت کی اصل وجوہات کا تعین کیا جائے گا تاکہ یہ واضح ہو سکے کہ آیا یہ واقعی خودکشی تھی یا اس کے پیچھے کوئی اور پہلو کارفرما تھا۔

stories.title: ریاست کو نقصان پہنچانے والا کوئی عمل قابل قبول نہیں، بیرسٹر افتخار گیلانی
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم آزاد کشمیر بیرسٹر افتخار گیلانی نے راولاکوٹ کا دورہ کیا جہاں انہوں نے زمینی حقائق اور عوامی مسائل کے عملی حل کا جائزہ لیا۔ اس موقع پر میڈیا کے نمائندگان سے خصوصی گفتگو کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ ریاست کو نقصان پہنچانے والا کوئی بھی عمل بہتری کا باعث نہیں بن سکتا۔

انہوں نے کہا کہ راولاکوٹ میں نقل و حرکت متاثر ہونے کی وجہ سے تعلیمی نظام شدید تباہی کا شکار ہے اور مریضوں کو بھی اسپتال جانے میں شدید مشکلات کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔ انہوں نے سوال اٹھایا کہ محض چند افراد کی وجہ سے آنے والی نسل کا مستقبل کیوں خطرے میں ڈالا جا رہا ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ تین گھنٹے تک فائرنگ کرنے والے عناصر پُرامن احتجاج کا دعویٰ ہرگز نہیں کر سکتے۔

بیرسٹر افتخار گیلانی نے مزید کہا کہ جو لوگ بچوں کے اسکولوں اور مریضوں کے اسپتالوں تک رسائی میں رکاوٹیں کھڑی کرتے ہیں، ان کی تحریک پُرامن نہیں کہلا سکتی۔ انہوں نے یاد دلایا کہ ماضی کے چار انتخابات میں یہاں کے عوام نے کبھی تعصب کی بات نہیں کی بلکہ ہمیشہ علاقے کی ترقی کا مطالبہ کیا۔ انہوں نے یقین دہانی کرائی کہ گورننس کا کوئی بھی مسئلہ اتنا سنگین نہیں کہ امن و امان خراب کیا جائے، لہٰذا عوام پرامن رہیں اور حکومت بہتری کے لیے پُرعزم ہے۔

stories.title: Analyst Warnings Surround Potential Lame Duck US President Donald Trump
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump's second term could face severe political disruption if Republicans lose control of Congress during the US midterm elections. Analysts suggest that a lame-duck status could make Trump particularly combative, noting his historical pattern of responding to political pressure with heightened resistance rather than acquiescence.

Trump has stated his intention to aggressively counter any legislative agenda if Democrats capture one or both congressional chambers, telling the New York Post that he would veto everything. The White House has also prepared for potential investigations and impeachment efforts, with Trump indicating a mutual approach to political investigations and a possible directive for the Justice Department to probe opposing lawmakers.

Foreign policy remains an area of broad executive authority for a lame-duck president. While Trump has considered renewing large-scale military operations against Iran, he has also pointed toward potential deals and the avoidance of a warmonger legacy. Speculation continues regarding the possible dismissal of Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth, while Trump simultaneously pursues settlement talks for Ukraine and plans potential summits with global leaders including Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping.

Rhetorically, Trump continues to shift attention toward home improvement and personal legacy projects, using his closing midterm remarks to highlight Washington renovations such as the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. While remaining coy regarding endorsements for potential 2028 presidential successors like JD Vance or Marco Rubio, analysts emphasize his ongoing focus on maintaining central political prominence.

stories.title: Industrial Copper Prices Fall as US Election Uncertainty Weighs Heavily
stories.summary:
Copper prices declined on Tuesday as risk-of sentiment affected industrial metals markets ahead of the US midterm elections. Additional downward pressure stemmed from a weaker Chinese yuan, which elevated the cost of dollar-priced commodities for buyers within China, the world's top consumer.

Benchmark three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange dropped 1.27 percent to $14,163.50 per metric ton by 0306 GMT. Simultaneously, the most-traded copper contract on the Shanghai Futures Exchange decreased by 0.18 percent to 108,380 yuan, equivalent to $16,302.65 per ton, as investors monitored the midterm elections for indications regarding future fiscal policy, public spending, and the trajectory of the US-Iran conflict.

David Wilson, head of metals strategy at BNP Paribas, noted that market volatility stems from uncertainty surrounding the midterms and conditions in the Gulf.
